feeds.title: Diane Arkenstone Blog
feeds.description: Diane Arkenstone is a music enthusiast who reviews music on her blog, dedicated to music. She listens to all genres of music and reviews them. Links to hear out the music are also provided along with the reviews.

feeds.title: New Age Music Reviews
feeds.description: New Age Music Reviews is a site that focuses on New Age Music from primarily independent artists from around the world. The site creator is Keith 'MuzikMan' Hannaleck, who also contributed reviews and was the founder of the MuzikReviews.com site. He ran that site for over 15 years, contributing hundreds of reviews, articles, press releases, and interviews as well as serving as the editor for a staff of writers.

feeds.title: New Age Music Guide
feeds.description: New Age Music Guide gives complete coverage of the New Age music genre. Here you will find breaking news, the popular web radio channel New Age Stars, the New Age Music Chart, and, of course, The New Age Music Guide itself.

feeds.title: New Age Notes
feeds.description: Immerse yourself in the soul-soothing realm of New Age Music. New Age Notes is a free internet radio station featuring the best New Age music artists on the planet today. Journey through ethereal melodies, artist spotlights, and the transformative power of sound.
